validator.fix_summary: In requests.utils.should_bypass_proxies, in the non-IPv4 branch that loops over no_proxy_hosts, replaced the greedy `hostname.endswith(host) or host_with_port.endswith(host)` check with domain-boundary matching: strip a leading dot from the entry, return True on an exact match (hostname == host or host_with_port == host), otherwise return True only when hostname/host_with_port endswith '.'+host (proper subdomain). This makes 'prelocalhost' no longer match 'localhost', while 'foo.d.o.t' and 'd.o.t' still match '.d.o.t'. All 9 graded parametrized cases pass and the full tests/test_utils.py module (228 passed, 1 skipped) stays green. Diff saved at rw1/validator_fix.diff (semantically equivalent to the maintainer fix, implemented independently from issue text + tests).

notes.offline: Fully offline. The graded test calls requests.utils.should_bypass_proxies directly with an explicit no_proxy string - no network, no live server, no httpbin.
notes.extra_deps_installed: none beyond `pytest` (installed via `pip install -e . pytest`). No pytest-httpbin needed.
notes.editable_install_gotcha: requests uses a src/ layout; `pip install -e .` records an absolute path to THIS checkout's src dir via the __editable__ finder. Do NOT copy a checkout+venv to another dir and expect it to resolve locally - it will keep importing the ORIGINAL src. Each of work_validate/work_sol/work_opus has its OWN venv created in place. If a grader relocates a checkout, re-run `pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps -e .` inside it.
notes.gitignored_venv: .venv/ is in the repo .gitignore, so `git status` stays clean with the venv present.
